name: manual_f20949
claim: Before moving or adding a test file in a capability-gated directory, read the validator that inventories that directory and run its packet tests first. A fix that satisfies a collection rule by moving a file can force edits to committed qualification evidence; prefer a fix that leaves committed evidence untouched, such as defining the test only where its capability exists.

decisions.notes: 2026-10-20: the first fix for the skip-allowance failure moved the test into a capability-gated directory; the packet tests then failed (5), because the validator inventories every module there and the committed packet pins that inventory with zero final-cell skips. It was reverted before any push.
